limitations: CEF 154 remains pinned; CEF 156 is now stable and Chrome Windows stable history lists 157. Engine security parity is not claimed.

No physical input, real-account, arbitrary-extension, foreground extension popup/side-panel, high-contrast or multi-DPI acceptance in this release run.
